testcase.name: ViewModel-owned actions have no host effect and no permission decision
the 35-row interaction ledger is complete and every row is owned
a disabled composer dispatches nothing and starts nothing
StartEngine is ViewModel-owned and never a permission decision
the review action returns its explicit destination
handoff and trust actions return explicit host effects
prewarm on dispatches without a redundant start
the three permission actions map to exactly three decisions
prewarm off starts the engine once and dispatches once
